mechanism: Unbounded routing probe: p=2 leaves Cross and the DirectContinuous guard becomes `(n ≤ 4 ∧ 2 < p) ∨ p ≤ 1000000`, so in practice every shape uses the direct row writer. DirectSmall/Packed10 remain in the kernel with their proofs but are unreachable for scored sizes. No other runtime bytes change.
hypothesis: If the direct row writer is competitive at every p on the public suite, the packed preparation and lane padding can be dropped as dead cost.
proof: No new proof obligation: each edited `if` keeps both branches and their existing spec theorems; only the decidable predicate changes.

edits.old: if n ≤ 4 ∧ 2 < p then DirectContinuous.core batch m n p A B
edits.new: if (n ≤ 4 ∧ 2 < p) ∨ p ≤ 1000000 then DirectContinuous.core batch m n p A B
